newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Randgold to buy Knights.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Randgold to buy Knights.

text.p: Randgold announced on Monday it was establishing a new company which would take over Knights and would also try to acquire the land-clearing and gold-recovery operations of RMP Properties Ltd.

This follows an agreement between Randgold and the Australian-based Continental Goldfields, which has an indirect 29-percent stake in Knights, to set up a Johannesburg Stock Exchange-listed vehicle, Randgold said in a statement.
The venture would be capitalised through a contribution of 95 million rand by Randgold and five million rand by Continental.
This company, provisionally known as Newco, will acquire the business of Knights through the issue of Newco units at an effective price of 40 cents per Knights share.

"If current negotiations between Randgold and RMP regarding the acquisition of RMP's land-clearing and gold-recovery operations should prove successful, these would be acquired by Newco and merged with Knights," Randgold said.

"Considerable progress has been made in these negotiations, with the structure of the transaction currently under consideration and the related due dilligence exercise scheduled for completion by the end of April."

Randgold director Dick Plaistowe said the proposed merger of the RMP operations with Knights would create a solid base for Randgold's intended development of a substantial gold recovery business on the Witwatersrand around Johannesburg.
